halpha_nonneg : 0 ≤ alpha.reason: The current source map classifies this as a visible corrected-target or model convention, not as a hidden archival implication.  The premise is therefore retained explicitly at the source-facing endpoint.
halpha_nonneg : 0 ≤ alpha.source_evidence: Pinned source SHA256 4dd55b1445de448e81d5494fbf9bafe4aac3f8c59f0ee62dac00aa1345dc4830; exact current source-map route prpkg_assumption_decaying_bernoulli_domain; route status `corrected`. The archival header simultaneously calls X_i^(t) iid Bernoulli and assigns the rank-dependent q_i=c(i+d)^(-alpha), which is inconsistent outside constant or degenerate cases. The corrected model uses independent rank-varying coordinates. The literal finite-law domain is alpha,c,d>=0 with q_1<=1; the top-one universal-optimizer branches additionally require c>0 and q_1<1. See PRPKG24-THEOREM2-RANK-VARYING-IID-01 and docs/THEOREM2_MODEL_CORRECTION_2026-07-27.md.
